authorization: User decision of 2026-11-03: revisit the unresolved adopted-data items as revisions of the adoption decisions; inference allowed under the instruction of 2026-11-02.
scope: Parameters of period-background-context-rule (r03, previously inline in scripts/build_period_scene.py) and its r05 revision. Applies to the modern building footprints used as inferred period context; it certifies no building's 1976 survival.

low_structure_exception.reason: Single-storey or smaller modern structures away from the route are not raised to the two-storey minimum.

evidence.what_supports: Modern footprints and heights used as the spatial scaffold; not evidence of 1976 buildings.

Re-inspected 2026-11-03 with footprints overlaid: at bldg_cef4146e-ec6f-4ba5-b496-2f93f8791e76 (aerial pixel about [221, 216], about 13.6 m west of the adopted Toho Kaikan front) the mosaic shows the light paved street/forecourt north of the plaza and no separate roof.
evidence.year_role: captioned capture year or capture-year range

assumptions: Storey scale, caps and the two-storey minimum are production rules, not measured 1976 heights.

26 modern footprints are lower than 5 m. 24 lie 38 m or more from the route and keep their modern height (3.0-4.9 m); bldg_1ddffcee (11.7 m from the route, 66 m2) keeps the 6.4 m minimum because the near-route storefront needs an upper storey; bldg_cef4146e-ec6f-4ba5-b496-2f93f8791e76 is omitted.
An object of about 3 x 3 m is about 3 x 3 aerial pixels; absence on the mosaic is not proof of absence.

contradictions.issue: Small modern structures turned into windowless 6.4 m boxes (r04 history critique, round c)
contradictions.resolution: r05 low-structure exception and one omission (see revisions).

alternatives.reason: Turns kiosks, sheds and stair hoods (2-30 m2) into blank two-storey boxes.
The aerial cannot show most of them either way; omission would remove scaffold without evidence.
No source identifies their 1976 use; the background is beyond the route's detailed facade radius.

alternatives.variant: keep the modern height for low background structures and omit the forecourt one
alternatives.reason: Least invention; the omission follows the aerial at the one site inside the theatre forecourt.

revisions.resolves: r04 unresolved item 4 (small modern plaza structures)
revisions.issue: The two-storey minimum raised 26 modern footprints lower than 5 m to 6.4 m; bldg_cef4146e-ec6f-4ba5-b496-2f93f8791e76 (3.1 m, about 10 m2, survey year unrecorded) became a windowless box in the theatre forecourt.

adopted.low_structure_exception: source height kept for footprints lower than 5 m and 38 m or more from the route

counter_evidence: The modern height of a small structure is not its 1976 height; it is only the least-invented scaffold.
Some small footprints in Kabukicho were two-storey buildings in 1976 (e.g. narrow bar plots); keeping a 3 m modern height may understate them.
inferred_parameters: 38 m route distance (same as the near-route facade radius)
revisions.checks: tests/test_adopted_data_review.py: no background building under 5 m source height is raised; the omitted feature is classified 'omitted' with this decision and kept in the modern baseline.

redistribution: No aerial raster is embedded in this decision file.
